title: The Judgment on the Female Prophets Who Enslave Souls
description: The Lord commands Ezekiel to prophesy against the daughters of the people who prophesy from their own hearts. They sew bands for wrists and make veils to enslave souls, lying to the people for their own gain. The Lord promises to tear apart the bands and veils, set the enslaved souls free, and save His people from their hand. [ref:Esek 13:17-23|Ezekiel 13:17-23]
